name: Ministry
overview: Ministry is a divine calling given by the Lord Jesus to faithfully proclaim the gospel of God's grace, as exemplified by Paul’s dedication to finishing his course with joy (Acts 20:24). It encompasses various roles including apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers, each gifted to equip the church for service and spiritual growth (Ephesians 4:11). The ministry also involves remembering and following the faith of those who have faithfully guided believers with God's word (Hebrews 13:7), while emphasizing the universal offer of salvation to all who call upon the name of the Lord (Romans 10:13).
